capabilities: List all customer lead time rules from SQL Server Agent job scripts
Get detailed rules for specific customers including ship date method and late thresholds
Update lead time business days for existing customers
Add new customer lead time rules to SQL CASE statements
Remove customer rules from SQL files
Preview changes as unified diffs before writing
Manage rules across two independent SQL files (shipping and production)

shipping.description: Open orders shipping report - sent to shipping team

production.description: Production schedule report - sent to production team

ship_date_methods.bus_days_created: dbo.BusDaysDateAdd(DATECREATED, N) - N business days from order created date
ship_date_methods.bus_days_ordered: dbo.BusDaysDateAdd(ORDERDATE, N) - N business days from order date
ship_date_methods.ship_expire_date: SHIPEXPIREDATE - customer-assigned ship date from ERP
ship_date_methods.calendar_days_ord_date: DATEADD(DAY, N, UDF_ORD_DATE) - N calendar days from UDF order date

known_differences: AMAZON.COM 3RD PARTY: 4 bus days in shipping, SHIPEXPIREDATE in production
BOB'S DISCOUNT FURNITURE: DATEADD(+14) in shipping, DATEADD(-14) in production
SAATVA INC product line 0065: 2 days in shipping, 1 day in production
Production file has additional customers: WAL-MART FBA, MATTRESS REDEMPTION, SONU Sleep
Shipping file excludes certain customers/items in WHERE clause; production does not

common_patterns.request: Change Mattress Firm lead time to 4 days
Add ACME Corp with 5 day lead time
What is Wayfair's current lead time?
